items.source: Factory method used to create the HeapDumpWebEndpoint.HeapDumper.
items.translation: 用于创建HeapDumpWebEndpoint.HeapDumper的工厂方法。

items.source: Web @Endpoint to expose heap dumps.
items.translation: 使用 Web @Endpoint 来暴露堆转储。

items.source: HeapDumpWebEndpoint.HeapDumperUnavailableException - if the heap dumper cannot be created
items.translation: HeapDumpWebEndpoint.HeapDumperUnavailableException - 如果无法创建堆转储器

items.source: HeapDumpWebEndpoint.HeapDumper that uses com.sun.management.HotSpotDiagnosticMXBean, available on Oracle and OpenJDK, to dump the heap to a file.
items.translation: HeapDumpWebEndpoint.HeapDumper 使用 com.sun.management.HotSpotDiagnosticMXBean（在 Oracle 和 OpenJDK 上可用）将堆内存转储到文件中。

items.source: Exception to be thrown if the HeapDumpWebEndpoint.HeapDumper cannot be created.
items.translation: 如果无法创建HeapDumpWebEndpoint.HeapDumper，将抛出异常。

items.source: Strategy interface used to dump the heap to a file.
items.translation: 用于将堆转储到文件的策略接口。

items.source: Lari Hotari, Phillip Webb, Raja Kolli, Andy Wilkinson
items.translation: Lari Hotari, Phillip Webb, Raja Kolli, Andy Wilkinson
